purpose: Conditional correspondence-development experiment on the four PHerc0139 w035 regions where prediction-connectivity-recovery-v1 already selected one wrong-wrap-safe surface-m7 component. The experiment changes only how the hidden 21x21 material grid is positioned on that already-selected component.
claim_boundary: A PASS establishes only that projected material-grid relaxation improves or preserves recovery on the four v1-selected development patches while staying on their exact v1 surface components. It does not repair v1's two component-selection abstentions, constitute a held-out result, prove arbitrary gap recovery, or justify Grand Prize transfer. Any promotion still requires an integrated frozen method and untouched holdout.

provenance.v1_failure_interpretation: Component identity was wrong-wrap-safe on four centers, but one-shot nearest projection inherited in-plane correspondence error from the harmonic prior. Two other centers abstained before component selection because one visible side lacked enough prediction-supported anchors.
provenance.selection_disclosure: This v2 cohort is explicitly selected from v1 development outcomes and is therefore development-only. No v2 success may be described as held-out validation.

identity_freeze.component_rule: Recompute prediction-connectivity-recovery-v1 byte-for-byte. The regenerated v1 candidate SHA-256 and selected component label must equal the frozen values above before v2 is allowed to proceed.

projected_relaxation.name: surface-constrained-material-laplacian-v1
projected_relaxation.initial_state: v1 recovered raw prediction voxel for every hidden material cell
projected_relaxation.fixed_boundary: Immediately adjacent visible TIFXYZ material neighbors outside the deletion rectangle. Only visible valid finite neighbors participate.
projected_relaxation.update: Synchronous Jacobi. For each hidden cell, average all available four-neighbor coordinates, using current hidden candidates and fixed visible TIFXYZ boundary neighbors. Query the same frozen v1 raw selected-component point cloud for the nearest raw prediction voxel to that average.
projected_relaxation.iteration_basis: exactly 4 times the frozen 21-cell deletion width; fixed before any v2 relaxation response
projected_relaxation.update_order: all proposals computed from the prior iteration, then committed simultaneously
projected_relaxation.component_geometry: raw prediction>127 AND masked CT>0 voxels belonging to the exact v1 selected connectivity label; dilation-only voxels remain forbidden as output geometry

candidate_firewall.metamorphic_expectation: Changing hidden truth after the deletion must not alter v2 candidate bytes.

development_gate.decision_rule: PASS only if every frozen condition passes simultaneously. Otherwise FAIL. Do not tune iteration count, projection radii, cohort, thresholds, or update rule after observation.
development_gate.pass_action: Treat correspondence as supported development evidence only. Next, preregister an integrated component-selection plus projected-relaxation method before opening untouched holdout.
development_gate.fail_action: Preserve the negative result and change the correspondence mechanism rather than tuning this one on the four observed patches.
